verifies.G072-C1: Add mapping method to mapper adds the entity-to-DTO method under the configured name pattern (mapperToDtoPattern=asModel) and the list method named by the collection strategy (mapperCollectionNaming=plural gives asModels) next to an existing @AfterMapping-free mapper; the existing members stay untouched. Naming patterns and the collection strategy are plugin settings, not the Tools | JPA Buddy | Mapper Declaration page.
